intro.title: Glass Blowing Experiences & Events
intro.text: Are you interested in the art of glass blowing? Our Denver-based glass blowing events are tailored to provide novice enthusiasts with a safe and controlled introduction to this exciting art form. Our spacious studio boasts of a professional ambiance that is perfect for sparking creativity. Additionally, we offer top-of-the-line safety equipment, torches, and a wide range of colors and materials to make your experience truly exceptional.

sections.title: Glass Blowing Experience
sections.description: Our most popular glass blowing class caters to individuals or small groups, regardless of their level of expertise, and guarantees an enjoyable and stress free experience. The class introduces the fundamentals of glass blowing, and you will be presented with a range of project options to choose from.

sections.title: Glass Blowing Date Night
sections.description: Experience a date night you won't forget! This class offers a distinctive opportunity to combine the color preferences and contributions of two individuals, resulting in a huge, one-of-a-kind, double-sided marble collaboration.

sections.title: Glass Blowing Birthday Bash
sections.description: Looking for the ideal experience for your artistic and creative friend? Look no further! With our private glass blowing birthday class, you and your special guest can create a unique piece of art.

sections.title: Team Building
sections.description: Bring your colleagues together for a unique team building activity! Come together with your coworkers to learn the basic of glass blowing and create pieces of glass art to take home.

instructor.title: Meet Your Instructor
instructor.description: Your instructor, Jon Wade, has over 15 years of experience in the art of glassblowing and is the founder of Denver-based glass company and studio, Wizard Glass. He has trained with several experts in the field and has even been highlighted in The Flow Magazine. His professional but laid back attitude makes for a relaxing but informative and fun experience.

studio.title: Our Studio
studio.text: Located in Englewood, our spacious studio boasts a professional ambiance that is perfect for sparking creativity. We offer top-of-the-line safety equipment, torches, and a wide range of colors and materials to make your experience truly exceptional.

team.name: Jon Wade
team.label: Owner / Founder
bio: Jon Wade has over 15 years of experience in the art of glassblowing and is the founder of Denver-based glass company and studio, Wizard Glass.
He has trained with several experts in the field and has even been highlighted in The Flow Magazine. His professional but laid back attitude makes for a relaxing but informative and fun experience.

101.title: Glass Blowing 101
101.description:
"Begin Your Journey With Us"

This private introductory class covers the basics such as safety, tools, and lighting your torch. It requires no previous experience and will give you the knowledge you need to continue your journey in Glass Blowing or even just a deeper understanding of the art.

While making two seperate projects, we will cover the fundamental techniques of both hollow and solid glass work. You'll learn tool usage, heating, and shaping in a structured environment designed to make you self sufficient enough to enjoy our less structured open house nights on Tuesdays.

*This class must be completed before booking the Adult Swim Night.

experience.title: Glass Blowing Experience
experience.description:
"Our most popular introductory class"

This class requires no experience and is designed for you (or your group) to have a GREAT time, regardless of your skill level. Learn the basics of coloring, blowing, and shaping glass as you create your own unique piece to take home.

In this class, you can choose to make anything from our huge list of projects including a paperweight, shot glass, plant terrarium, pipe, pendant, bud vase, candle holder, bird sculpture and many others. Mix and Match from any of our 30+ colors to give your project a personal color pallet and even add an opal to catch the light just right.

Our expert teachers will provide whatever assistance you need all the way through your project to ensure it comes out perfect in the end.

couples.title: Couples Glass Blowing Date
couples.description:
"A truly unique date experience"

Denver’s Hottest Date Night is a romantic and creative visit to our spacious, climate controlled studio!

In this intimate, lower capacity class, you will work together with your partner to create a one of a kind marble with colors and patterns formed by both of you. Each person will create their color combination from over 30 colors and hand select a beautiful opal from our array of colors and shapes. The opals are used to represent people in our projects as they are each unique, much like a fingerprint.

You can choose to combine your individual sections into the huge 3/4 pound collaboration marble or create separate projects, your choice. Other projects include plant hangers, shot glasses, candle holders, bird sculptures, bud vases, or many others.

Our expert teachers will be there every step of the way ensuring a fun, stress free atmosphere, as well as helping with the shaping to make sure every project comes out great! There are also several great restaurants nearby to complete your evening or grab drinks after.

ornament.title: Holiday Ornament Glass Class
ornament.description:
"Celebrate your holidays with us"

Our widely popular ornament class is a great family holiday experience or date night. We open bookings in November. Be sure to keep a lookout around that time. If you would like to make a larger window hanging ornament, we make those in our Glass Blowing Experience year round.

Our expert instructors will guide you through the process of crafting classic ornaments, starting with choosing your favorite color combinations from our color wall. After coloring your glass you will blow into it, expanding the ornament to its beautiful round shape. With plenty of time to make two ornaments, you'll have the opportunity to keep one and give the other as a thoughtful gift (or keep both if you choose).

party.title: Family/ Private Glass Party
party.description:
"Create memories with us"

This is the perfect outing for any group or family with a passion for art and creativity. During your private session, you and everyone in your group will get to craft their own one-of-a-kind piece. The private session also gives enough time for any younger guests to have the attention they need if you are booking a class for a family with young children.

Everyone in your group can select from a range of projects including air plant terrariums, plant watering bulbs, bud vases, bird sculptures, shot glasses, marbles and pendants. You are welcome to choose the same projects or everyone can make something different, your choice.

Your group will have all the help and instruction you need to make sure every project comes out perfectly and is a beautiful reminder of your class together. Come make memories with us.

team-building.title: Team Building Events
team-building.description:
"Let us ignite your team"

Our teaching facility is an amazing space, tailored for private events. We typically hold team building events on Tuesdays and Wednesdays and keep those days open for private classes. If you need another day of the week, feel free to inquire about a specific date and time as well. Our classes are typically 2-3 hours depending on the amount of students.

During your class, each member of your group will choose their own colors and projects so that everyone can individualize their experience and create something they want and will use. Each person will also have all the help they need to ensure their art comes out perfect in the end. Our focus is on empowerment and giving every student the personal sense of accomplishment that the glass provides.

The list of projects include shot glasses, candle votives, a variety of plant terrariums (that include a free airplant!), plant watering globes, bud vases, ornaments, and bird sculptures.

If any of your team members are unable to attend the class, we have premade items from every category in our list for you to chose from and take for them to unbox. All the projects will cool down in the kiln overnight and many of our guests choose to have unboxing parties at the office showing off their art. These premade projects allow everyone in your team to participate, even if they were unable to attend the actual class. We also have shipping options.

Our pricing for Team Building Events is:

$120 per person for groups of 4-12 people
$100 per person for groups of 13-30 people

*This price includes your full studio rental, a cooler of ice-cold water, multiple instructors, materials, and all the safety equipment you need.

Contact Us Today to Secure Your Date and Time.

youth.title: Youth Glass Blowing Class
youth.description:
"A safe and fun introduction to glass art designed with younger students in mind"

This is our one-on-one glass art class for kids ages 6 and up. With one-on-one attention from the instructor, your child will feel safe and supported as they learn the basics of glass blowing and create their own stunning piece of art. In a day your child will never forget, they will create a beautiful marble or a wearable pendant as well as another project of their choice from our extensive list. Watch your child's excitement as they bring their artistic vision to life and experience the thrill of glass blowing.

Our mission is to inspire the next generation of artists and encourage your children to explore their artistic passions. If you believe your child is ready for the experience, even at a younger age, please don't hesitate to reach out. We are happy to customize the class for their level of maturity and ensure their safety, while still giving them a great experience and art to bring home.

celebration-of-life.title: Celebration of Life Class
celebration-of-life.description:
"Craft a lasting memento with a loved one"

Be a part of the process as we create a lasting memorial in honor of your loved one.

This private class for one or two people will allow you to use cremation ashes to create a pendant, paperweight, marble, or worry stone. You will select your colors, delicately add the ashes to the project, then swirl them together to create your masterpiece. If you book the class for two people, each person will create a separate project.

You will need about a tablespoon of fine ash to complete your project. If you are more comfortable bringing the ashes in the original container and opening them with us in class, we can do that together.
celebration-of-life.review: I highly recommend take a class a Glass Class Denver. I took the Celebration of Life class to create something & memorialize someone I love dearly. It was an emotional yet educational and fun experience. I found it to be a helpful part of my grief journey. Jon Wade and all the staff were extremely helpful, friendly and supportive.

hero.title: Torch Station Rentals
hero.description: Experienced glass artist? Rent time on our professional torch stations. We offer hourly and daily rates for qualified artists.

rentals.requirements: Prior glass blowing experience is required for all rentals. New renters must complete a brief safety orientation and shop tour before their first session.
